visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of small icon tiles linking to the site topic sections
visualCharacteristics.summary: Small square solid-blue icon tiles with only a link label, in one row of 9.

contentPattern.structure: one cell: an :icon: token (e.g. :economiayhacienda:) and a link
contentPattern.notes: Repeating look-alike items (icon and link) that flow and wrap, and become a carousel on mobile. The icons are icon-font glyphs, so this uses the no-images card model.

usage: Topic or category navigation tiles with an icon glyph and a short link label. Swipe carousel on mobile, single row on desktop.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for icon-plus-label link tiles without photos. Use cards-features when each item also has a heading and text.
